d:
Lok aastha ke mahaparv chhath ko lekar rajdhani ranchi men taiyariyan joron par hain. chhath vratiyon aur shraddhaluon ki suvidha ko dhyan men rakhte hue jila prashasan aur ranchi nagar nigam ki tim lagatar chhath ghaton ka nirikshan kar rahi hai. is bar chhath mahaparv ke dauran ghaton par suraksha ke vishesh intjam kie ja rahe hain.
